source.source_title: AirPods 4 with Active Noise Cancellation - Tech Specs
source.verification_notes: Official Apple technical-specification page discovered from its documentation index; 13 sections archived. Model identifiers and introduction year cross-checked against Apple's official AirPods identification page on 2026-11-09.
notes: Model numbers and introduction year verified against official Apple AirPods identification page: https://support.apple.com/en-ie/109525.

extraction.note: Official Apple source sections are preserved and transcribed. Explicit chip, Bluetooth version, resistance rating, battery-duration statements and labelled size/weight measurements have been parsed where present; values retain source-section provenance. Model/case-specific context, footnotes and remaining fields still require record-level verification. No missing values inferred.

sections.heading: Accessibility
sections.source_text:
Accessibility features help people with disabilities get the most out of their new AirPods.
Features include:
Live Listen audio
12
Headphone levels
Headphone Accommodations

sections.heading: System Requirements
sections.source_text:
iPhone models with the latest version of iOS
iPad models with the latest version of iPadOS
Apple Watch models with the latest version of watchOS
Mac models with the latest version of macOS
Apple TV models with the latest version of tvOS
Apple Vision Pro with the latest version of visionOS
AirPods can be used as wireless Bluetooth headphones with Apple devices using earlier software and with non‑Apple devices, but functionality may be limited.

sections.heading: AirPods and the Environment
sections.source_text:
AirPods are designed to reduce environmental impact:
13
Materials
100% recycled tin in the solder of multiple printed circuit boards
100% recycled gold in the plating of multiple printed circuit boards
100% recycled copper plating salts on multiple printed circuit boards
100% recycled rare earth elements in all magnets
50% recycled plastic in three parts
100% fibre-based packaging
14
Energy
Meets US Department of Energy requirements for battery charger systems
15
Waste
No established final assembly sites generate waste sent to landfill as part of Apple’s Zero Waste Programme
Smarter chemistry
16
Mercury-, BFR- and PVC-free
